title: Defuse Deserialization
prompt: Implement load_payload(data: bytes) that safely decodes untrusted payloads: try JSON (utf-8) and return the object; on any failure raise ValueError('unsafe payload'). The docstring must promise never to use pickle (graders check json is used and pickle is NOT).

tests.name: non-json raises safely
pickle is not used
tests.code: assert 'pickle' not in code, 'pickle.loads executes embedded code'
tests.hint: Untrusted bytes must never reach a pickle loader.
